entries.label: verdict検証器の不在の機械確認
argv:
import json
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('config/development-issue-resolution-pilot-v2.json', 'config/development-issue-resolution-pilot-v3.json', 'config/development-issue-resolution-pilot-v4.json'):
    config = json.loads(Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    fields = config.get('record_fields', {}) or {}
    print(name.rsplit('-', 1)[-1], 'verdict_fields', fields.get('issue_resolution_verdict'), '| resolution_verdict' in json.dumps(config))
text = Path('tools/development/issue_resolution_pilot.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print('dispatch_has_resolution_verdict', 'resolution_verdict' in text)
old = json.loads(Path('.reviewcompass/workflow/resolution-verdicts/verdict-pilot-todo-growth-001--v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print('old_verdict_record_kind', old['record_kind'])
